title: [finding] `ObjectGantt.reload`'s host-`data` short-circuit fires on an EMPTY array, so the day the wrapper forwards host props an api-provider gantt paints an empty chart instead of its endpoint's tree
body:
Measured while implementing objectui#7222 (the false `ganttOwnsData` comment in `plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`). Filed unassigned, as a reading — this is **latent**, not a live defect: it is unreachable today for the same reason objectui#7222 exists.

## Measured

`packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx`, inside `reload`:

```
// 1. Check for data prop (Unified ListView)
if ((rest as any).data && Array.isArray((rest as any).data)) {
  if (isCurrent()) setData((rest as any).data);
  return;
}
```

`[]` is truthy, so an EMPTY host rows array satisfies both halves of that guard: the component adopts it and returns, before the `hasInlineData`/`value` branch and before the `effectiveDataSource.find` call. "The host handed me zero rows yet" and "the host has nothing for me" are the same input.

## Why it is unreachable today

`ObjectGanttRenderer` (`plugin-gantt/src/index.tsx`) destructures `({ schema })` and hands `ObjectGantt` exactly `schema` and `dataSource` — no host prop reaches `rest` at all (objectui#7222; pinned in `packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.hostDataProp-7210.test.tsx`). So `rest.data` is `undefined` on the registry path whatever the host does.

## Why it matters anyway

It is the failure mode waiting on the other side of the wrapper question. If `ObjectGanttRenderer` is ever made to spread `{...props}` — the shape objectui#7210 half 2 weighs — then for a gantt view authored with `data: {provider:'api', …}`, `ListView`'s own rows array is a truthy `[]` **forever** (its fetch effect returns early for that view, `ListView.tsx`, the `ganttOwnsData` branch). Forwarding it would short-circuit the chart's own endpoint fetch and paint an EMPTY chart — silently, and not the "stale object rows" the old comment predicted.

`ListView` withholds the prop for exactly that case today, so nothing is broken right now; the guard is what would have to be preserved, and this guard here is what would have to be tightened.

## Suggested shape (not a decision)

Gate on length rather than truthiness — `Array.isArray(rest.data) && rest.data.length > 0` — or on an explicit "the host owns the rows" signal, so an empty page cannot masquerade as an authoritative answer. Which of the two is right depends on how objectui#7210 half 2 lands, so this should not be changed as a drive-by.

Refs: objectui#7222 (where this was measured), objectui#7210 (half 2, the open wrapper/ceiling decision).
